handoff: review#8: review#7 fixes hold, tests green, D1-D5 sound, every B item traced. Blocking F1 (B15/B41/B42): the 'Rerun at its check' guard (SKILL.md:42, git log -1 <branch> newer than the check receipt's at) is always true, because norn commits '<check>.fail → implement' and 'implement started' after the receipt, so no rerun at its check ever happens. Ignore runs/-only commits. Minor: run cancel not recorded as delegated, the hung-CI order (gh run cancel not named), RoundReceipt comment doc. Table in handoff.

findings.title: 'Rerun at its check' guard is always false: norn's own transition commits are newer than the check receipt
findings.detail:
SKILL.md:42 says: 'Only while the branch has no commit newer than the check receipt's `at` (`git log -1 --format=%cI <branch>`; a newer commit means implement already works on it, leave it)'. norn commits to the story branch at every transition, after the receipt. On gh-195 (e.g. 2026-11-05T11:24:43 'norn: gh-195/10 test.fail → implement'), a failed check is followed by a '<check>.fail → implement' commit and then an 'implement started (run …)' commit. Both touch only runs/. On this branch, 0054-check.json has at 12:12:21Z, and norn's 'test.pass → review' commit (48d302f81) is at 12:12:42Z. So `git log -1 <branch>` is always newer than the receipt's `at`, and a supervisor following the text never reruns a CI glitch (B15), a failure on load (B41) or a suspected flake (B42). The spec asks for these reruns: spec.md:151 says 'the same test passes on a rerun with no commit in between', and B15 says 'with no newer commit on the branch'.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make the guard ignore norn's own runs/-only commits. For example, compare the receipt's `at` with `git log -1 --format=%cI <branch> -- . ':!**/runs/**'`, or compare the head the check ran on (if the receipt records it) with the newest non-runs/ commit. Pin the new command in the assets terms, and make sure the docs lint still accepts it.

findings.title: A supervisor's run cancel is recorded as the person's, with no reason
findings.detail:
SK3 allows the supervisor `norn run cancel` before a rerun at its check, and says 'Each decision it makes is recorded as delegated, with its reason'. run cancel has no --delegated or --reason, so the record shows 'cancelled by person'. The delegated rerun that follows carries the reason, so the gap is small.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Either add --delegated --reason to run cancel, or have SK3 and the skill say that the cancel is a mechanical step whose reason is carried by the rerun that follows.

findings.title: The 'hung' CI run case has no working order of steps
findings.detail:
While the CI run hangs, the `ci` check is still watching it. `run cancel` refuses (no running agent), and GitHub refuses `gh run rerun --failed` on an in-progress run. The skill says to rerun first, which cannot be done until the run ends or someone cancels it on GitHub, and it never names the cancel. The same gap applies when implement has not launched yet: `run cancel` refuses with nothing_to_cancel, and the skill does not cover that.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Name `gh run cancel <id>` for a hung run (or say to wait for its timeout) before `gh run rerun --failed`. Say what to do when run cancel finds nothing to cancel.

findings.title: RoundReceipt comment doc still says 'required with delegated'
findings.detail:
The AnswerReceipt comment says the schema does not require it, but the RoundReceipt `comment` description still says 'required with `delegated`', which is not enforced. Also, `delegated: true` is accepted on by: agent receipts, while the doc says 'a person's receipt'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Make the two descriptions match.

findings.title: Shipped skill and sources carry this story's process history
findings.detail:
The shipped skill text says '(B24, B40)' and '(two claims were lost that way)', which mean nothing in a user's repo. Source comments cite review rounds ('review#7 F6', 'review#1 F4', …) in place of rule or spec ids. story-edit.ts:264 reads --delegated/--reason raw before delegation() reads them again.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Drop the spec ids and the anecdote from the shipped skill, and cite gh-196 D/B ids in place of review rounds.

findings.title: No test reruns an actual check step; B7 and B11 are only partly asserted
findings.detail:
The flake test in delegated.test.ts reruns `--step work` (an agent step). No test asserts B7's 'no `norn status <story>`' or B11's permission-prompt option.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Optionally rerun a check step in the harness, and add the missing terms.
